map.为什么总利息常接近甚至超过本金？: Why does total interest often approach or exceed the principal?
map.长期低月供下，前期大部分月供用于付息，本金摊还慢，累计利息巨大。缩短期限或提高月: Under long terms with low payments, most early payments go to interest and principal amortizes slowly, so cumulative interest is huge. Shortening the term or raising the payment significantly cuts total interest.
